title: Gryphon openCypher-TCK Coverage Ledger
description: Corpus-wide TCK mining coverage keyed by feature folder. Governed by plugins/gryphon_playground/specs/spec-gridkin-v0.md (req-gridkin-tck-coverage). `covered` is derived by the guard (test_tck_coverage_ledger), never stored here.

folders.description: One entry per openCypher TCK feature folder that at least one scenario's inspired_by cites.

folder.description: Real TCK feature folder path, e.g. 'clauses/match' or 'expressions/null'.

gaps.description: Applicable TCK intents NOT yet covered by any scenario citing this folder — the recorded, actionable coverage debt.

intent.description: The uncovered corner-case intent, in TAP's own words (clean-room; no TCK text).

note.description: Why it matters / what it guards against.

kind.description: test = closeable by authoring a scenario (Gryphon already supports it); feature = needs a Gryphon language feature first; unknown = not yet classified (probe against the executor).

excluded.description: TCK intents deliberately filtered out as Cypher-specific / outside Gryphon's read-only contract.

intent.description: The excluded intent, in TAP's own words.

reason.description: Why it is out of Gryphon's contract.

no_applicable_folder.description: Features whose scenarios have no applicable TCK folder (TAP-native, or a surface the TCK does not cover). Each scenario in these features carries the empty-pass inspired_by marker.

self_authored.description: True when the scenarios were authored without any TCK source.
